title: Local EPS bearer context deactivation without NAS signalling

entities.name: Local EPS bearer context deactivation
entities.description: Procedure where UE and MME deactivate EPS bearer contexts locally without peer-to-peer ESM signalling based on indications from lower layers about user plane radio bearer status.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is not registered with the network.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection not supported
entities.description: Condition where either UE or MME does not support EMM-REGISTERED state without an active PDN connection.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection supported
entities.description: Condition where both UE and MME support EMM-REGISTERED state without an active PDN connection.

entities.name: Last remaining PDN connection for non-emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition where the last remaining PDN connection being deactivated is for non-emergency bearer services, leaving only emergency PDN connection.

entities.name: Deactivate all EPS bearer contexts in PDN connection
entities.description: Behavior where if default EPS bearer context is locally deactivated, all EPS bearer contexts associated with that PDN connection must also be deactivated.

entities.name: Perform local detach
entities.description: Behavior where UE or MME performs local detach procedure when last PDN connection is deactivated and EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported.

entities.name: Consider attached for emergency bearer services only
entities.description: Behavior where UE or MME considers the UE to be attached only for emergency bearer services when last non-emergency PDN connection is deactivated.

relations.description: Local EPS bearer deactivation procedure establishes the behavior of deactivating all EPS bearer contexts in a PDN connection when default bearer is deactivated.
Local EPS bearer deactivation procedure behavior is guarded by condition of EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection not being supported.
Condition of no PDN connection support establishes the local detach behavior.
Local detach behavior establishes transition to EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Condition of both UE and MME supporting EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection establishes transition to EMM-REGISTERED state.
Condition of last non-emergency PDN connection deactivation establishes the behavior of considering UE attached for emergency services only.
